The release channel choice. It shows only while Release is on. A build whose store owns the channel shows the picker locked, with the reason.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="React">
    <KitStatus kit="react" />

    **Drop-in.** `<ChannelPicker />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, inside `<PolarisKeyProvider config={polarisKey}>`.

    **Styled part.** The same component given an `input`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("ChannelPicker", input)` returns the view: its state and the copy keys it shows.

    [React](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/react/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<ChannelPicker />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<ChannelPicker />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("ChannelPicker", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** Settings draws it for an app on the release service; it is hidden otherwise.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisChannelPicker`, given a `PolarisChannelUi`: locked by a store, by the license, or free to pick. `onSelect` null draws nothing unless locked.

    **Headless.** `PolarisChannelUi` in `polaris-key-ui-core`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisChannelPicker
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisChannelUi

    @Composable
    fun Channels(switchTo: (String) -> Unit) {
        PolarisChannelPicker(
            channel = PolarisChannelUi(current = "stable", options = listOf("stable", "beta")),
            onSelect = switchTo,
        )
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the Android sample, the theme and the account list.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="ChannelPicker" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
